title: FIB
tagline: A Madlibs style AI card game. Fill in the Blanks to complete the story and win prizes for the best results. You don't have to tell the truth, you just have to FIB.
description:
We wanted to come up with an interactive way to engage users while also exploring how AI generations can elevate everyday gaming experiences.

For V1 users are able to claim a ticket to play FIB if they hold:

1) A Farcaster Power Badge
2) A weekly game pass (nft) 

Once the user is validated they are able to play the current FIB . There are three frames which are combined with the users input to complete the story. This is then sent to generate. The image is returned to the user and they can then submit their play, which goes to a gallery showing all submissions.

Farcaster users can vote on their favorite submisssions by logging in on the FIB site. The top 2 entries split a majority portion of the pot from the tickets sold that week.
how_its_made:
We used Nextjs, Coinbase Onchain Kit and Vercel to create a React App.  
The FIB stories were created custom by us as well. We wanted to try and appeal to the lore of FC with the initial stories, but think these could be custom to channels as well in the future.
Weekly game passes were minted on Base via Hypersub
Generation is done via Fal.ai, the structured prompts were also created by us.
The images created by the user are pinned to Pinata and shown in a gallery view.

Top languages - Typescript, CSS, HTML, Javascript
